Hotel Policy | Rosewood Kauri Cliffs
Hotel Policy
Taxes
Room Rates are inclusive of 15% Government Goods and Services Tax.
Deposit
For 3 rooms or less, a one-night deposit is required to confirm a reservation, and a valid credit card must be held on file to maintain a secured reservation.
To maintain a confirmed reservation between December 20 th  to January 10 th , full payment is due 1 August, and is non-refundable on cancellation.
Reservations of 4 rooms are considered a group and booking conditions apply. Group bookings are taken at the sole discretion of the property and additional conditions may apply.
Cancellation
For stays (3 rooms or less) between May 1 st to September 30 th :
Cancellation outside 31 days of arrival will incur a $250 booking administration fee. This will be deducted from the deposit paid, and the balance of funds returned.
Up to 31 days prior to arrival you may postpone travel dates to a revised stay date within six-months of the original booking and the full deposit will be transferred.
Cancellation between 31 and 15 days of arrival will result in a 50% charge for room nights cancelled.
From 14 days prior to arrival, cancellation will result in the full charge for room nights cancelled.
For stays (3 rooms or less) between April 1 st  to April 30 th , October 1 st  to December 19 th  and January 11 th  to March 31 st :
Cancellation outside 90 days of arrival will incur a $250 booking administration fee. This will be deducted from the deposit paid, and the balance of funds returned.
Up to 61 days prior to arrival you may postpone your travel dates to a revised stay date within six-months of the original booking and the full deposit will be transferred.
Cancellation between 90 and 61 days of arrival will result in a 50% charge for room nights cancelled.
From 60 days prior to arrival, cancellation will result in the full charge for room nights cancelled.
For stays (3 rooms or less) between December 20 th  to January 10 th :
Cancellation prior to 1 August will incur a 10% charge.
Cancellation from 1 August to date of arrival will result in the full charge for room nights cancelled.
Reservations of 4 rooms are considered a group and booking conditions apply. Group bookings are taken at the sole discretion of the property and additional conditions may apply.
Please note that cancellation policies may vary depending on the specific offer selected at the time of booking. Please review the cancellation policy associated with your chosen offer, as different terms and conditions may apply.
Payment
Payment can be made by Visa, Mastercard, American Express or Bank transfer. A 2.6% convenience fee will be applied to payments made by credit card.
Arrival and Departure
Check-in is from 2 pm on the day of arrival and check-out is at 11am on the day of departure. For early check in or late check out are subject to availability and upon request. Luggage storage service is provided if needed and guests are welcome to use the lodge facilities.
Transfers
Rosewood Kauri Cliffs offers a private transfer which can be requested with our concierge. An extra fee applies.
Additional Person Policy
Rosewood Kauri Cliffs is a child-friendly resort and offers a range of services for children of all ages. Cribs are available complimentary for children up to the age of 24 months. Children aged 2 - 5 years are charged at NZ$250.00 plus 15% Government Goods and Services Tax per night when occupying adult's room using existing or additional bedding. A charge of NZ$745.00 plus 15% Government Goods and Services Tax per night will apply for the additional person/bed for children 6 years and over.
Pet Policy
No pets allowed.
Smoking Policy
Rosewood Kauri Cliffs has implemented a smoke-free policy as a commitment to providing a safe and healthy environment for guests and associates alike. Our smoke-free policy applies to cigarettes, cigars, pipes (including electronic and e-cigarettes), and vape pens or e-cigars.
Drones Policy
The use of unmanned aerial systems is strictly prohibited on or above resort property.

Location | Rosewood Kauri Cliffs
Location
Rosewood Kauri Cliffs
139 Tepene Tablelands Road, Matauri Bay, Northland, New Zealand
Getting there
Nearby Airports
Kerikeri Airport (KKE): 34 km, 30 min drive
Kerikeri Airport is a 40-min flight from Auckland Airport (AKL)
Air New Zealand operates daily flights from Auckland to Kerikeri Airport. Charter flights can also be organised.
Auckland is one of the most connected cities in the Pacific, with direct flights from Australia, North America, South America, Asia, and the Middle East.
Scenic Transfers
Helicopter: Private scenic helicopter transfers
Rosewood Kauri Cliffs has its own EC130 helicopter, which can be hired for transfers into and out of Auckland.
The transfer to Kauri Cliffs is a 1-hour scenic coastal flight, touching down directly on the helipad at the lodge.
Add-On Services
Transfer: Sedan, SUV and limousine services
Private luxury transfers can be arranged through the concierge.
